embeds.title: 🚀 Start a real company
embeds.description: New computer app: START-UP. Pick an idea (AAA game studio, AI model, factory, smartwatch, phone brand, social app, electric cars, biotech, fashion, food delivery, space rockets), give it your own name and put in your own money. Day one is your bedroom.

embeds.title: 💼 It pays you real money
embeds.description: Every profitable month the company pays a dividend: 25% of profit, times your share, taxed 25%, straight into your bank account. Pay yourself more when you need it, or sell the company for your share.

embeds.title: 👥 Team & buildings
embeds.description: Hire employees, supervisors, a manager and a head of HR. Move from your room to an office, a facility, a headquarters, and finally a skyscraper with a meeting table over the whole city.

embeds.title: 🦈 Investors
embeds.description: Pitch angels, VCs, mega funds and sovereign funds. They bring cash and take a share. At creation, choose how it appeals: a safe pitch is easy to fund but caps out low, a moonshot is a hard sell with double the ceiling.

embeds.title: 🌳 Skill tree
embeds.description: Profit, speed, payroll and pitch, 3 levels each. Earned with launches, bigger buildings and steady profits. Three months in the red and the company folds. Millions are possible, but not easy.

embeds.title: 🕊️ Diplomatic status
embeds.description: Founder → CEO → Tycoon → Magnate → Diplomatic. A billion-dollar company in a skyscraper makes you untouchable: no police, no jail, no cancellations. For life.

embeds.title: 🏋️ Gym & movie dates
embeds.description: New gym date: lift together, spot them, race on the treadmill, then sneak into the locker room or head home. Movies get flirting in the dark and the back row. No restroom there, it happens right in your seats.

embeds.title: 😏 Make a move on a friend
embeds.description: Take a friend on the same date scene, but it's harder: every moment needs more spark and they might dodge the first kiss. If they kiss back, you're talking.

embeds.title: 🏡 They ask you
embeds.description: Partners text: "movie tonight?", "can I come over?", "come over to mine?" When they're deeply in love, they pick where (couch, bed, kitchen counter) and how (a quick one, all night, or no condom; you can always insist). Married? You can ask too.

embeds.title: 💉 Stats on steroids & a fix
embeds.description:
New computer app. Pick any stat, slide or type the level you want, and pay $100 (or €100) per level, up to 100. Max health and energy can go from 100 all the way to 300. Karma isn't for sale.
Fixed: no more school events or school rivals once you've left school.
